data.narrative:
Iambic Therapeutics is a Series B-stage biotech company that has raised $350M+ to date. Valuation triangulation draws on a peer universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in Biotech & Health, with particular relevance from same-stage proxies including Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B, Series C), Chai Discovery ($3.8B, Series C), and New Limit ($3.1B, Series C).

Two methods prove applicable. Stage-progression analysis anchors to $350M in total raised and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yielding $665M. Peer-median valuation across the three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produces a median of $3.8B, with a range spanning $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales (sector median 8.1x across the three public tickers) cannot be applied, as Iambic's revenue is not disclosed. This gap is typical for private companies at this stage.

The two applicable methods triangulate to a range of $565M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.2B. The wide band reflects material dispersion in peer valuations and uncertainty around whether Iambic maps closer to the lower end (stage-adjusted raised capital) or the upper range of comparable funding multiples. Key uncertainties center on clinical readout timing, regulatory pathway clarity, and the company's positioning within the broader competitive set.
